text:
Palladium Price in 2007
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2007, the LBMA palladium price rose 10.0% between 2007-01-31 ($331) and 2007-12-28 ($364). The highest sampled price was $371 in April and the lowest was $330 in August. The mean of these observations was $354. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
